**Introduction to Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd.**

Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading high-tech enterprise specializing in the research, development, production, and distribution of cyclodextrin and its derivatives. Located in the Boxing Economic Development Zone of Binzhou, Shandong Province, China, the company is strategically positioned in one of the country’s most dynamic industrial hubs, benefiting from advanced infrastructure, robust supply chains, and a thriving business environment. With a strong commitment to innovation and quality, Huike Cyclodextrin has established itself as a trusted partner in the global chemical and pharmaceutical industries.

Founded on a foundation of scientific expertise and technological advancement, the company focuses on the production of high-purity cyclodextrins, including α-cyclodextrin, β-cyclodextrin, γ-cyclodextrin, and their modified derivatives such as hydroxypropyl-β-cyclodextrin (HP-β-CD) and sulfobutyl ether-β-cyclodextrin (SBE-β-CD). These versatile molecules are widely used in pharmaceuticals, food and beverages, cosmetics, agriculture, and environmental protection due to their unique ability to form inclusion complexes, enhancing solubility, stability, and bioavailability of active ingredients.

Huike Cyclodextrin operates under strict quality management systems, adhering to international standards such as ISO 9001 and GMP, ensuring that every product meets the highest levels of purity, consistency, and safety. The company’s state-of-the-art production facilities are equipped with cutting-edge technology and automated processes, enabling large-scale, efficient, and environmentally responsible manufacturing.

Beyond production, Huike Cyclodextrin is deeply invested in research and development, collaborating with universities, research institutes, and industry partners to drive innovation in cyclodextrin applications. The company’s technical team, composed of experienced chemists and engineers, provides customized solutions to meet the specific needs of clients across diverse sectors.

With a customer-centric approach, Huike Cyclodextrin serves a global clientele, exporting products to markets in North America, Europe, Asia, and beyond. The company’s dedication to excellence, sustainability, and continuous improvement has earned it a reputation for reliability and integrity in the chemical industry.

As a forward-thinking enterprise, Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd. is not only a key player in the cyclodextrin market but also a driving force in advancing green chemistry and high-value-added chemical solutions for a sustainable future.
